title: Clifford Brown phrasing in his solo; Bill Bailey overdub reaction
summary: Davenport notes Armstrong and Clifford Brown phrases in the solo; Wood recalls the studio reaction when trombone and bass were dubbed on Bill Bailey.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
